open_media_container: open a video or audio media file container using PyAV for decoding
load_video_frames: load video frames from a container at a specified FPS and time range
extract_video_clip: extract a video clip starting at a given time with a specified duration
load_audio_samples: load audio samples from a container with optional resampling to a target sample rate
extract_audio_clip: extract an audio clip from a container starting at a given time with a specified duration
